mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question_bank_questions (bank_id, question_type, stem, options_json, answer, analysis, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{bankId}, #{questionType}, #{stem}, #{optionsJson}, #{answer}, #{analysis}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM question_bank_questions WHERE bank_id = #{bankId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM question_bank_questions WHERE bank_id = #{bankId} AND question_type = #{questionType} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE question_bank_questions SET bank_id = #{bankId}, question_type = #{questionType}, stem = #{stem}, options_json = #{optionsJson}, answer = #{answer}, analysis = #{analysis}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE question_bank_questions SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
